# GovInfo

> > Official repository of federal government documents published by the U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO), providing free public access to presidential papers, Congressional Record, and official publications.

GovInfo serves as the digital archive maintained by GPO in partnership with the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) and the Office of the Federal Register. The platform provides authenticated access to historical and current government documents including presidential addresses, congressional proceedings, and federal regulations.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO)
- Congressional Record
- Presidential Documents and Public Papers
- Office of the Federal Register
- National Archives and Records Administration (NARA)
- State of the Union Addresses
- Presidential Archives (Trump, Biden, Obama, Hoover administrations)
- House of Representatives and Senate Proceedings
- Compilation of Presidential Documents
- White House Press Secretary Records
- Joint Sessions of Congress
- Federal Government Documents
- Authenticated Government Publications

## Presidential Documents

- [State of the Union](https://www.govinfo.gov/features/state-of-the-union): Presidential State of the Union addresses archive with Congressional Record

## Optional

- [Page Not Found](https://analytics.govinfo.gov/): 404 error page with GPO contact instructions for reporting issues
